bestBets.overview: AZONTO finished off strongly to score two starts ago, then again loomed like the winner last week but was nailed right on the line. She's a strong chance to atone. EAGLEFURTHER disappointed third up but has since placed in a Longford trial and may get a soft time of it up front. FLOSSING found the line nicely in open company last time and this is easier but he's yet to prove himself on synthetic. ALPINE BLAST battled away soundly despite being posted wide last week and draws for a much softer run.

raceTips.comment: Azonto ran well last start against similar opposition. She hasn't done a whole lot of winning of late but does get a great opportunity to get another win here. Flossing was good late last start but can be slowly away in his races. Eaglefurther's best would see her right in the finish.

bestBets.overview: The speedy ALPINE THUNDER was back to his best when leading throughout third up. He's unknown on synthetic but again looks the likely and should take plenty of wearing down. BOLD INSTINCT was never likely off a freshen but will be better for the hitout and he usually races well here. WITHIN SIGHT is also untried on synthetic but she should be ready to show more at her third run this term. VOLKANOVSKI failed to finish off last start but had looked close to another win prior.

raceTips.comment: Alpine Thunder should found the lead here and be very hard to rundown. He won impressively last start and looks the horse to beat again. Volkanovski was good two runs back and could bounce back here. Within Sight has Top 2 claims at his best.

bestBets.overview: Former Victorian CITY WOK scored a comfortable maiden win over 1150m at his local debut before rising to this trip and again proving too strong last week. He's a top chance for the hat-trick. BELLA CHINKARA closed well behind him last time and meets him 1.5kg better. Her stablemate FIERCE 'N FABULOUS displayed encouraging second up improvement at this track before battling away evenly when back to turf. BELLSPROUT has been in the minors when new and has tuned up for this with a pair of trial wins.

raceTips.comment: City Wok has been flying for the new stable and won very well last start. This race isn't much stronger plus he should get a good run just stalking the speed. Bellsprout has trialled well and may get favours on speed. Fierce 'N' Fabulous is set to peak now third up.

bestBets.overview: Small field but all five have genuine claims. STARDARMUS appears back to his best having scored at two of his past three outings. He drops 2.5kgs on last week's soft win and Newitt sticks. SIMPLY DEEP was only worn down late after working hard on pace last time and another spirited bid is expected. The promising SH'BOURNE POWER is unknown on synthetic but must be respected. STONE COLD STUNNER was found wanting late after leading second up but will be getting fitter and was Group 3 placed two runs before the break.

raceTips.comment: Simply Deep should lead here and get plenty favours in run. He brings in the strongest form here and drops in grade from Open class here. Sh'bourne Power is flying and is looking for a hat-trick of wins. Kakia looks ready to win but will need some luck.

bestBets.overview: STOLLAWAY NED found the line nicely after getting back from a wide draw at his 1100m debut before again closing well to just miss over this route next try. He shouldn't remain a maiden much longer. HARRATA has ben good to the line over 1150m at both runs this time in and will appreciate the added 200m of this assignment. Former Victorian mare LYREBIRD LADY was a noted drifter in betting when placing at her local debut and must be taken seriously this time. SYMPHONY QUEEN showed ability in her first campaign and has been readied for this with a trial placing.

raceTips.comment: Stollaway Ned attacked the line in good style last start and should've gone very close to winning. He looks to have plenty of upside and strikes a winnable race here. Lyrebird Lady ran improved race last start for the new stable. Harrata should be strong from back in the field.

bestBets.overview: ALKIRA proved no match for a dominant all-the-way victor when heavily supported at her first attempt. She won both lead-in trials prior and must be kept very safe again. PRECIOUS ILLUSION battled away okay when in the market fresh and will be better for that hitout. ROLAND VIEW had support at juicy odds when placing third up off a long break and should now be at peak fitness. The debutante MOBILO is in good hands, draws kindly and has placed in his past two trials.

raceTips.comment:
Alkira was off the map in betting on debut here she started $1.40. She ran the fastest 6,4 and 200m sectionals of the meeting. Craig Newitt going aboard looks a big positive for her winning chances. Eydoit has shown some ability at the trials. 
Macelleroy can improve here, he didn't have much luck last start.

bestBets.overview: BILLIE THE GREAT is yet to score on synthetic but she's placed at five of seven attempts and has been a model of consistency this time in. She just needs a little luck from the wide gate to be playing a role in the finish again. MATERIAL MADAM also draws poorly but she's proved when new and was narrowly denied in a recent Hobart trial by smart stablemate Zany Girl. ZOETE'S ROCK is building toward another win and is not unsuited back in trip. WILD NIGHTS sat too far back last week but had been holding form well prior.

raceTips.comment: Our Pepmenartie run a good race last start at Hobart against strong opposition. This looks to set up well for him from the drawn. Billie The Great is flying but will need some luck from the draw. Geegeechaser should get favours on speed from barrier two.

bestBets.overview: COAL RIVER battled away soundly behind an all-the-way victor fresh, then was untroubled leading throughout second up. He'll be further improved and another bold showing is expected. SUSHI EXPRESS was beaten for the first time from six tries over this trip at Hobart third up but is two from two this route including a win in this event last season. GARCON D'ESPOIR is becoming costly but keeps performing well and will have admirers again. ZEWINNA hasn't been far away of late and should get all the favours form the inside marble.

raceTips.comment: Coal River looks to set peak now third up. He won in good style last start and should get favours from the lead here. Garcon D'espoir is ready for 1600m now fully fit and was unlucky last start. Sushi Express could get favours on speed.

bestBets.overview: THEM'S THE BREAKS had been finding the line well prior to being unsuited in a race controlled by the leader fourth up. She can bounce back at likely each-way odds. DON TURBOAS hit the line hard to miss narrowly two starts ago before sitting too far back last time. LAST TREMBLE has found her second win elusive but has been performing honestly of late and should be around the mark again. His stablemate BRUNY BOY was untroubled leading throughout at his third attempt and has plenty of upside.

raceTips.comment: Bailed should be better for the run last start where he was caught wide the trip but fought on bravely for 2nd. He looks well placed here to break his maiden. Bruny Boy won in good style last start and looks progressive. Them's The Breaks had no chance of winning last start in a slow run race,C Newitt going aboard is a big positive.
